summary: Frontend testing of hero redesign (dark navy + gold) and ZirveAilesi page unified grid. All 10 acceptance criteria verified and passing after forcing frontend recompile (webpack hot-reload file watcher was not detecting file changes automatically in container — required supervisor restart).

issues: Yatırım Simülatörü modal pops up on every page load (including /zirve-ailesi). While presumably intentional, it is disruptive during automated testing. Not a bug, but may need a session-based 'shown once' flag if it's a promotional popup.

action_items: IMPORTANT ENV/INFRA: Webpack hot-reload file watcher is NOT detecting file changes in this container environment. When E1 makes frontend code changes, the dev server does not automatically recompile. Changes only take effect after `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`. Consider adding WATCHPACK_POLLING=true or CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true to frontend/.env to fix this for future iterations.
OPTIONAL: The Yatırım Simülatörü promotional popup shows every page load — consider adding sessionStorage tracking so it shows only once per session.
critical_code_review_comments: Webpack hot-reload not working: frontend/.env lacks WATCHPACK_POLLING=true or CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true, causing webpack to not detect file changes in the container. This means code changes require a supervisor restart to take effect.
Hero h1 animation classes include opacity-0 (starts invisible) — animation system must override this for the text to be visible. Ensure CSS animations are defined and not broken.

ZirveAilesi page: The `if (!settings)` loading guard returns a spinner, which means the page is blocked until /api/family/settings responds. Any API failure causes infinite spinner — consider adding error state with retry option.

The event_is_active flag is currently false so completed card is showing. 4 speakers in DB with 1 founder (Muhammet Özdemir). Year filter shows 2026/2025/2024.

rca_of_issue: Before testing, webpack hot-reload had not compiled the latest HomePage.jsx changes (file modified at 20:57, webpack log last updated at 20:52). Browser was serving stale bundle with old text-summit-navy class instead of new text-white. Root cause: container filesystem likely uses inotify which may not trigger webpack's chokidar watcher properly. Fix: restart frontend supervisor OR add WATCHPACK_POLLING=true to frontend/.env.
